rows.title: Roles and addresses page: intro, warning, Consignor name, named add links and full addresses
rows.detail: Brings the live-animals roles and addresses page's words and rows in line with Design Release 2.1, inside the summary list DR1 kept (c-087). The page gains an intro paragraph. The fraud warning loses its full stop. The consignor party is called 'Consignor' rather than 'Consignor or exporter'. Every empty row offers a link that names what it adds instead of a bare 'Add'. An answered row shows the whole chosen address, not just the name, so a trader can check every address without opening each picker. Ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm carries the 'Consignor' rename to the high-risk plants frontend's consignor picker and its check-answers label in the same change, so the two services name the party the same way. Every new or changed string carries a Welsh machine draft.
acceptanceCriteria: Under the heading 'Consignment addresses' the page shows the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-004; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-004; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-004)

The warning reads 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud' with no closing full stop, and its Welsh text has no closing full stop either (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-005; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-005; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-036; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-030)

The consignor row is labelled 'Consignor', and the consignor picker's heading and page title say 'Consignor', in English and Welsh; 'Consignor or exporter' no longer appears on either page, and the consignor picker's address is unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-020, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-137; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-008, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-030; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-034, repo-frontend-p9-090)

In the high-risk plants frontend, the consignor picker's heading and page title say 'Consignor', and check your answers labels the consignor 'Consignor', in English and Welsh; 'Consignor or exporter' no longer appears on either page, and the consignor picker's address is unchanged (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-037; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-056, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-059, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-081)

Empty rows offer the links 'Add a place of origin', 'Add a consignor', 'Add a consignee', 'Add an importer' and 'Add a place of destination', each opening that party's picker (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-019, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-023, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-027; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-034)
An empty CPH number row offers the link 'Add a CPH number', opening the CPH number page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-028; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-017)

An answered party row shows the name on its own line, then each address line on its own line, the last ending with a comma and the country name, such as 'Hull, HU9 5PX, United Kingdom' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-032; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-033; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-046; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-027)

With either frontend in Welsh, every string this change adds or alters shows a Welsh counterpart, still marked as an unreviewed machine draft (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-029, repo-frontend-p9-089, repo-frontend-p9-090; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-048-m1; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-031)
The roles and addresses page has no serious or critical accessibility violations (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-176)
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil. The requirements behind it did not change in substance; the provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claim (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-037 for the plants Consignor rename) and the current plants claims (repo-plantsfrontend-p6-056, p6-059, p6-081). Combines four thin slices that all change the roles and addresses page's copy and rows: the intro and warning, the Consignor rename, the named add links and the full address on answered rows. Each repeats the same page, copy files and tests, so building them apart gains little. The plants rename rides along because req-564 puts it in the same increment. The summary list stays (c-087); the prototype's headed sections are set aside. c-103: the consignor's id, route and address-book role stay as they are in both frontends, and the animals overview task hint 'Consignor or Exporter, ...' stays. The plants overview hub copy that also names 'Consignor or exporter' is not named by req-564 and is left as it is. c-089: the visually hidden suffix on the add link goes, as the link now names the party. req-619 (Welsh for every new or changed string) sits here, and every other row of this area keeps the same rule. The tests repo's animals page object and flow that name 'Consignor or exporter' and the 'Add' link, and the plants consignor page object and review spec, change with it. The germinal-products set's copy of this page (req-1827) is taken after this row lands, so it inherits these changes. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Party picker layout: add button, search control, results heading and count, address lines and blank save
rows.detail: Brings the five live-animals party pickers' layout in line with Design Release 2.1. By ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm, the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers change with them. The search label is medium and the search runs from an icon button. A 'Select an address' heading and a reworded results count sit above the table. The table sits in one fieldset. Each address line takes its own line. Saving with nothing chosen is no longer an error. On the animals pickers 'Add a new address' becomes a secondary button beside the heading; the plants pickers, which offer no add control, stay without one.
acceptanceCriteria: On each of the five animals pickers on the compose stack, 'Add a new address' is a secondary button beside the picker's heading, and no 'Add a new address' link sits under the intro; in stub mode the pickers offer no add control (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-054; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-029; repo:tests repo-tests-p5-022, repo-tests-p5-024)

The high-risk plants consignor and place of destination pickers still offer no 'Add a new address' control (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-036)

On the animals pickers and the plants consignor and place of destination pickers, the search label 'Search' is styled as a medium heading (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-038; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-001)

On those pickers the search runs from a search icon button beside the box whose accessible name is 'Search'; there is no secondary 'Search' text button, and with JavaScript turned off pressing the icon button narrows the list on the server (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-071; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-053, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-038; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-003, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-004)

Under the search, each of those pickers shows the heading 'Select an address' above the results count (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-059; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-056; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-017; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-008)

The results count reads 'Showing <visible> out of <total> results' in English, with its Welsh counterpart, and changes when a search narrows the list, on the animals pickers and the plants consignor and place of destination pickers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-059; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-036; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-018, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-019; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-008, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-049)

On those pickers the address table sits inside one fieldset whose legend 'Select an address' is read by a screen reader but not shown (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-057; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-010)

On those pickers the Address column shows each address line on its own line, with no commas joining them (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-066; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-011)

On an animals picker, pressing 'Save and continue' with no address chosen shows no error and returns to the roles and addresses page, the party still empty, or still holding the address it held before (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-072, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-073; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-103; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-055)

On the plants consignor or place of destination picker, pressing 'Save and continue' with no address chosen shows no error and moves on to the page that picker's save leads to, the party still empty or still holding its earlier address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-039; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-032, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-034, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-075, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-086)

On both frontends, choosing an address that is not, or no longer, in the organisation's book is still refused with its party error (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-181; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-019, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-088)

Every new or changed string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart, and every changed picker has no serious or critical accessibility violations (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089, repo-frontend-p9-188; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-049, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-078, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-087)

rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil; no requirement behind it changed in substance. Provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claims (p1-035 every search a form with a submitting button, p3-015 no plants equivalent leaves plants alone, p3-038 plants picker layout, p3-039 plants lenient blank save) and the current plants claims. Combines the picker's presentation slices (add button, search label and icon button, heading, count, fieldset, address lines) with the blank-save change. All change the picker template, its copy and the same tests in each frontend, so building them apart would repeat the set-up for little gain; the plants half is the same change to the plants pickers, reviewed against the same criteria. c-093: where 'Add a new address' leads stays as today's INS handshake (c-106, party-address-add-and-edit area); only its look and place change here. c-105 and c-094: the icon button submits the form, so search still works without JavaScript; the search field and action the k6 scripts drive stay as they are (req-1828, exists). c-095: the count moves out of the table caption. c-098: a blank save is no longer an error, but the refusal of a record not in the book stays in both frontends (req-604). The pickers keep 'Save and continue' alone (c-099). The tests repo's animals e2e tests and the plants parties and destination specs that expect the 'Select a <party> from the list' error on a blank save and the comma-joined address change with it. The existing row inc-086 also holds req-1964 (the plants consignment contact picker takes the same layout) and the c-292 question with its default; they are another area's, so this draft leaves them for the combiner to carry over. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Role-filtered party pickers on one page
rows.detail: Gives every address-book record one or more roles, and makes each live-animals party picker, and the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers, offer only the organisation's addresses for its role, all on one page. The address book stores the roles and lists one role's addresses unpaginated; each frontend asks for its picker's role. Records saved before roles existed are offered on every picker until given a role, so nobody loses an address on a guess. Stub mode in both frontends gets roles on its canned records, so it filters too. Because each page is now one role's addresses, pagination and the 'Selected address' inset go. Search stays the server search behind the submitting search button; filtering as the trader types waits on design in its own row.
acceptanceCriteria: On the compose stack, an address saved with only the consignee role appears on the consignee picker and not on the place of origin, consignor, importer or place of destination pickers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-070, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-098; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-047)

An address saved with the exporter role appears on the consignor picker; there is no separate exporter picker (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-064, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-137; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-116)
An address saved with several roles appears on the picker of every party whose role it carries (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-065)

On the compose stack, the high-risk plants consignor picker offers only addresses carrying the consignor role and the plants place of destination picker only those carrying the place of destination role, each with the role-less records too (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-040; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-006)

An address-book record with no role appears on all five animals pickers and on both plants pickers, on the compose stack and in CDP (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-051; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-040)

The address book returns an organisation's addresses for one requested role in a single unpaginated list, carrying each record's roles, and never returns a deleted record (document:dr1-parity-notes document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-022, document-dr1-parity-notes-p1-023; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-050, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-052; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-115)

In stub mode, each animals picker and each plants picker lists only the canned records that carry its role (with any canned record that has no role), so the pickers do not all list the same addresses (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-168, repo-frontend-p9-169, repo-frontend-p9-170; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-092)

Each animals picker and each plants picker lists every address it offers on one page, with no page-number links and no Previous or Next links, however many addresses the role has (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-063; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-052, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-056, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-041; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-007, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-021)

No animals or plants picker shows a 'Selected address:' inset; a party's chosen address shows as its checked row when the picker is reopened (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-050, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-055; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-041; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-017)

Submitting a search still narrows the one-page list on the server in both frontends (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-066)
rows.gate: Look at role filtering on the compose stack and in stub mode, in both frontends, before the rows that rest on it build: a role-carrying record appears only on its roles' pickers, a record with no role appears on every picker, the list is one page, and the server search narrows it. The same-as row, the place of origin country search, the live filter row and the germinal set's copy of the pickers build on this.
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil; no requirement behind it changed in substance. Provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claims (p1-066 builds inc-087 now, p3-040 and p3-041 the plants half) and the templates ruling's same-time rule (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-044), which req-594 now cites. Combines role filtering (address-book roles and a role-scoped list, each frontend asking by role, the role-less fallback, stub roles) with one-page listing and dropping the 'Selected address' inset, because c-094 rules they land together: one page is only sensible once it is one role's addresses, and the inset only existed to carry a selection across pages. req-592 (filtering as the trader types) stays out: it is blocked on design question 5, in its own row. c-100: DR1's typed-record block is lifted; the typed record is built in trade-imports-address-book. Its field shape for roles is the address book's own design (req-611, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-116). The record's type and uses are inc-059's, in the address-book theme, which this row depends on; the role-scoped list sits in the address book's service code, and the record shape in its address package is shared with that theme. c-101: role-less records show on every picker until given a role, in the compose stack and CDP alike, never filtered on a guess; in CDP every record saved before this lands has no role, so the criterion is observable there. Both frontends' address-book services stay read-only (c-106, req-618). Giving a record its roles through the INS address book's add and edit pages belongs to the address-book-add-and-edit and party-address-add-and-edit areas; on the compose stack the role-carrying records these criteria use are set-up for a one-page assertion through the address book, which the test rules allow. The picker's search must still answer a 255-character term (req-1828, exists, driven by the k6 scripts). The animals stub book mirrors the tests repo's address-book fixture record for record, so both gain roles together. The tests repo's pagination and later-page-selection tests (repo-tests-p5-013, p5-018, p5-020) and the plants picker specs change with it. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Same-as shortcuts on the roles and addresses page
rows.detail: Lets a trader fill the consignor from the place of origin, and the importer and place of destination from the consignee, with one button press on the live-animals roles and addresses page, as Design Release 2.1 draws. The button copies the source party's record onto the notification as an independent copy, so a later change to the source does not ripple through.
acceptanceCriteria: With a place of origin chosen and no consignor, the Consignor row shows a 'Same as place of origin' button styled as a link beside 'Add a consignor' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-042; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-049)

With a consignee chosen and no importer, the Importer row shows a 'Same as consignee' button styled as a link beside 'Add an importer'; with a consignee chosen and no place of destination, the Place of destination row shows a 'Same as consignee' button beside 'Add a place of destination' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-043, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-050)

No same-as button shows while its source party is empty or its target party already has an address, and no other pair of parties offers one (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-049, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-050; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-038; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-020)

Pressing a same-as button reloads the roles and addresses page with no success banner, the target row showing the source party's name and full address with a 'Change' link and no same-as button (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-035, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-045, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-046, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-047, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-051)

After copying, changing the source party to a different address leaves the copied target party's address as it was (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-052; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-021)

The copy is made even when the source address does not carry the target party's role, and the target party then shows that address (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-099)

The copied party carries the source's name, address lines, country and contact details through to check your answers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-036; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-085, repo-frontend-p9-086)

The same-as buttons work with JavaScript turned off, and every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Unchanged from the existing row: no requirement behind it moved. Combines the three same-as buttons and their shared show and copy rules: one page form, one copy behaviour, one set of tests. c-100: DR1's collision block does not hold this back. Today the summary list sits outside the page's form (document-dr1-parity-backlog-p6-023), so the buttons need the form around them. The prototype's same-as-<source>:<role> action value is not adopted (req-1829, out of scope): the button posts the real service's own fields. Ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm leaves plants unchanged here: plants has no roles and addresses page to carry the shortcut (p3-015). Order: build after the roles and addresses page copy row (it asserts the full address and the named add links) and after the role-filtered pickers row (the 'copy even when the target's picker would not offer it' criterion needs role-carrying records). On the compose stack the role-carrying record for that criterion is set-up for a one-page assertion, allowed by the test rules. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Place of origin picker searches by country
rows.detail: Gives the live-animals place of origin picker the country search Design Release 2.1 draws, built as ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm directs. It has its own label, hint and placeholder. The search is the real frontend's accessible autocomplete over a native select of the countries MDM serves through reference-data, with a button that submits the chosen country so the server keeps only the addresses in that country. Without JavaScript the native select and the button do the same. Filtering as the trader types waits on design and is not part of this row.
acceptanceCriteria: The place of origin picker's search is labelled 'Enter a country' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-072; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-035)

Its hint reads 'Enter each country that the consignment will travel through' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-127, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-103)

With JavaScript, its search box shows the placeholder 'Search for a country' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-072; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-010)

With JavaScript, the country search is an autocomplete offering the countries the service's country list holds, behaving as the frontend's other country autocompletes do (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-079-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-005, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-009)

Choosing a country and pressing the search button reloads the picker showing only the addresses in that country, with the results count to match; pressing it with no country chosen shows every address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054)

With JavaScript turned off, the picker shows a select of the same countries, and choosing one and pressing the search button narrows the list in the same way (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-007, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-044; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054)
The other four pickers keep their 'Search' label and free-text search, and every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-053, repo-frontend-p9-089)
The place of origin picker has no serious or critical accessibility violations with the country search in place (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-188)
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil; no requirement behind it changed in substance. Provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claims: p1-005 to p1-009 (the frontend's accessible autocomplete over a native select, MDM's entries, the component's own mechanics), p1-010 (label, hint and placeholder follow the prototype), p1-035 (every search a form with a submitting button), p1-044 and p1-069 (the no-JavaScript half is built now), p1-020 and p1-022 (the search box's look and wider rollout are EUDPA-635's). c-102: the prototype's own country widget, its as-you-type row filtering and its custom announcements are set aside; the as-you-type country filter waits on design as req-1951, in its own row. The placeholder is built now, which only the autocomplete can show. Combines the place of origin picker's label, hint, placeholder and country search: one picker, one search control. The search keeps the real service's field name and action (req-1829 out of scope, req-1828 exists); the native select may need a country value alongside the free-text q the k6 scripts drive, which the plan stage settles without breaking req-1828. The country list comes from the frontend's existing countries service (reference-lists theme); the accessible autocomplete component is the journey foundation's, used here, not changed. The plants frontend has no place of origin picker, so plants is unchanged (p3-015). Order: build after the role-filtered pickers row, whose one-page list this narrows, and after the picker layout row, which reshapes the search control. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Picker 'View' link to the INS address book and back
rows.detail: Replaces each live-animals picker row's in-place 'View details' expander with a 'View' link that opens the address in the INS address book, and makes the INS address book bring the trader back to the same picker. The INS frontend stays the one place an address is shown in full. The high-risk plants pickers are not wired to the INS address book and keep their 'View details' disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Each animals picker row ends with a 'View' link, and there is no 'View details' expander (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-060)

On the compose stack, following 'View' opens that address in the INS address book, and its back control returns the trader to the same party picker of the same notification (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-061; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-062)

The high-risk plants consignor and place of destination pickers keep their 'View details' disclosure and offer no 'View' link (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-064; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-012)
The 'View' link has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil; req-601 is unchanged in substance, and its plants exclusion now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claim ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-064. The plants criterion is a guard that the plants pickers are left alone; it touches no plants code, so plantsfrontend is not in repos. Kept apart: it is the area's only change to the INS frontend and carries a cross-service return path the others do not. c-097: the prototype wins; the INS frontend must honour the return path, and the tests repo's in-place expander test (repo-tests-p5-014) changes with it. In stub mode, where no INS frontend runs, the fit suite observes the link's presence only; where it leads is observed on the compose stack. The builder should accept only a return path inside the animals journey, as the INS add handshake already does (journey-registry), so the link is no open redirect; this is a safeguard, not a source requirement, so it is left out of the criteria. The return to a germinal products picker is req-1831's concern, not this row's. The existing row inc-090 also holds req-1960 (each picker row links to its record in the INS address book and back), another area's; this draft leaves it and its criterion for the combiner to carry over. Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Which sections the roles and addresses page shows, when its task is complete, and where it continues
rows.detail: Makes the live-animals roles and addresses page ask for exactly what the consignment needs and say honestly when it is done. A 'Permanent address' section appears for 01061900 consignments with a species that needs one. The task counts as complete only when every shown section is. 'Save and continue' goes on to the contact address for this consignment page in the opening run, or to the overview once everything is complete or when the page was opened from its overview task. The CPH number exemptions stay as they are today: ruling sam-2026-10-09 moves the germinal codes into their own set (req-1826) rather than adding them to the live-animals exemption list.
acceptanceCriteria: For commodity code 01061900 with at least one selected species that needs a permanent address, the page shows a 'Permanent address' section with the hint 'A permanent address is where an animal:', the bullets 'will permanently reside' and 'can be checked by the Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA)', and the link 'Add a permanent address' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-013, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-016, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-019, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-022, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-023, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-024)
No other consignment shows the 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-019; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p14-026)

The overview's 'Roles and addresses' task shows Complete only once every party has an address and, where shown, the CPH number or permanent address is given; with any shown section empty it is not Complete (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-039, prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-080)

On a new notification's opening run, 'Save and continue' on the roles and addresses page opens the contact address for this consignment page, not the CPH number page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-048, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-197)

On the opening run, when every overview section is already complete, 'Save and continue' opens the overview instead (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-044; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-124)

Opened from its overview task, the roles and addresses page returns to the overview on 'Save and continue' and does not run on to the CPH number page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-198)
Reached from check your answers to change an answer, 'Save and continue' still returns to check your answers (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-026)
Every new string has a Welsh machine-draft counterpart (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Unchanged in substance from the existing row; no requirement behind it moved. Combines the page's permanent address section, task completion and the continue destination: they share the parties obligations and the journey flow, and are reviewed together as one behaviour. c-104 (completion counts every shown section), c-092 and c-204 (the opening-run continue goes to the contact address page; a page opened from the overview returns to it; the change-context return stands). req-574 (exempt only 0101 and 01061900) is adopted as exists and its germinal half is req-1826, so no criterion names the germinal codes. Where the 'Add a permanent address' link leads, and the permanent address pages, are the cph-permanent-and-contact area's. Order: inc-001 builds the opening-run step order and inc-002 the overview return (req-1615) in the journey flow; this row builds on them and proves them from this page rather than building the flow change twice. It also depends on the permanent address page (inc-054), the CPH number page row (inc-091) and the contact address page row (inc-094), whose pages its links and continue destination open. The tests repo's page flow expects the CPH number page after this page today (repo-tests-p1-086) and changes with it. This row changes shared code (the parties obligations, the journey flow) that other areas also touch. Plants is unchanged: it has no roles and addresses page (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-015). Theme: consignment-parties.

rows.title: Germinal products roles and addresses page and party pickers, with no CPH number or permanent address page
rows.detail: Gives the germinal products set its own roles and addresses page and its own five party pickers, copied from the live-animals addresses feature once this area's rows have built it, as ruling sam-2026-10-09 directs (germinal products is a sibling set of duplicated feature pages). The copy behaves as the live-animals page and pickers do, with the same words and hints, except that a germinal consignment is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: the set has no CPH number and no permanent address section, and serves no CPH number or permanent address page. A trader importing germinal products can then record every party of the consignment within the germinal notification.
acceptanceCriteria: From a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Roles and addresses' task opens a 'Consignment addresses' page with the caption 'Consignment parties', the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' and the warning 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud', within that germinal products notification (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122)

For every germinal commodity the page shows exactly five sections, in this order: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination; it shows no CPH number section and no 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

The germinal products set offers no CPH number page and no permanent address page: nothing on its pages links to one, and opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

Each section's hint reads as on the live-animals page, word for word, including Place of origin 'The address where the animals begin their journey to Great Britain' and Place of destination 'This is where the animals will be unloaded and accommodated for at least 48 hours. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address.' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-046)

Each empty row's link ('Add a place of origin', 'Add a consignor', 'Add a consignee', 'Add an importer', 'Add a place of destination') opens the germinal set's own picker for that party; choosing an address there and pressing 'Save and continue' returns to the germinal page, which shows the full address with a 'Change' link, and the address is saved on the germinal products notification only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-001)

The germinal pickers offer the same addresses for each role, on one page, with the same server search, place of origin country search, 'View' link, results count and blank-save behaviour as the live-animals pickers; 'Add a new address' shows as a secondary button beside the heading on the compose stack and is left out in stub mode (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal page offers the same-as buttons ('Same as place of origin' on Consignor; 'Same as consignee' on Importer and Place of destination) under the same rules as the live-animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal overview's 'Roles and addresses' task shows Complete once all five parties have an address, with no CPH number or permanent address asked for (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

In Welsh the germinal page and pickers show the same Welsh text as the live-animals ones, and they have no serious or critical accessibility violations (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-089)
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil only for this area's requirements; neither changed in substance. Combines req-1826 (the germinal half of req-574: five sections only, no CPH number or permanent address) and req-1827 (the germinal set's own copy of the page and pickers), because they are one page and one copy: building the copy without its section rule would show a CPH row the set cannot answer. Ruling sam-2026-10-09 (p1-014) says each germinal page is copied after this programme has built its live twin, so this row lands after every buildable live-animals row of this area (inc-085 to inc-090, inc-096); the germinal-products theme already depends on the consignment-parties theme, so that order holds through the themes. It never waits on the blocked live filter rows (inc-193, inc-197): those change the germinal pickers too when they build. Ruling p1-058 puts the germinal set in one theme, germinal-products, in the last wave: this row belongs there, not in consignment-parties. The existing row inc-181 also carries req-1832, req-1833 and req-1840 and their criteria, from other areas; the combiner should carry them over again, with the existing dependencies on the germinal set's mount, journey and overview. The routes and form fields stay the real service's, with the live-animals slugs (req-1828 exists, req-1829 out of scope). Same behaviour in stub mode and on the compose stack, as for the live-animals pickers. Theme: germinal-products.

rows.title: Waiting on design: party pickers filter as the trader types
rows.detail: With JavaScript, narrows a party picker's list as the trader types, with no page reload, on both animals sets' pickers and the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers, as DR1 and Design Release 2.1 both wanted. It waits on design: until design, with the product owner, answers design question 5, the server search behind the submit button is the whole search. It is built as design answers, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps it under question 5, with JavaScript, typing in the search box of a live-animals or germinal products party picker hides, without a page reload, every row whose name, address lines and country do not contain the typed text in any case, and the results count updates to match (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-074, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-075, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-076; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067)

The high-risk plants consignor and place of destination pickers filter in the same way as the trader types (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-050, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-042; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p6-004)

With JavaScript turned off, submitting the search still narrows the list on the server (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-052, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p7-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035)
Clearing the search box shows every row again, and the count returns to the full total (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-102)
openQuestions: Design, with the product owner, must answer design question 5 (live filtering as the trader types) before this builds; if design drops it, this row is dropped. Until then the server search behind its submit button is the whole search (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm).
rows.notes: Re-drafted on this re-distil; req-592 is unchanged in substance and still has blockedBy (design question 5, ruling sam-2026-10-09-pm, c-094), so the row stays blocked. Provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claims (p1-052, p1-053 and p1-063 live filtering waits on design and the product owner; p1-067 one increment for question 5; p1-050 and p3-042 plants changes too). Client-side code is new; neither frontend's picker carries JavaScript today (repo-frontend-p9-070, repo-plantsfrontend-p6-004). Depends on the role-filtered pickers row (one page to filter), the picker layout row (the results count it updates) and the germinal set's pickers (req-592 names both animals sets), as the existing row does. The existing row inc-193 also holds req-2039 (the INS address book list re-requesting as the trader types), another area's, under the same design question; this draft leaves it, and the insfrontend repo, for the combiner to carry over. Theme: waiting-on-design.

rows.title: Waiting on design: the place of origin picker's rows filter as the trader types
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 narrows the place of origin picker's rows as the trader types or picks a country, with no page reload. That needs custom JavaScript no accepted component gives, so it waits on design question 6. The version that works without JavaScript, a country choice submitted with its button so the server narrows the rows, is built now in the place of origin country search row. Built as design answers, in both animals sets, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps it under question 6, with JavaScript the place of origin picker's rows filter as the trader types or picks a country, keeping the rows whose country contains the typed text or exactly matches the picked country, with no page reload, on the live-animals and germinal products pickers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p6-073; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-070)

Without JavaScript the picker still narrows its rows when the chosen country is submitted with its button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-035, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-069; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-055)
openQuestions: Design answers design question 6 (the place of origin picker filtering as you type), alongside question 5 on live filtering, which goes to the product owner too (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm). Who: the design team. Built as design says, or dropped if design drops it.
rows.notes: This area now drafts req-1951, which areas.json gives to consignment-parties; the existing row inc-197 was drafted by the combiner when it sat in no area. Provenance now cites the renumbered afternoon ruling claims (p1-069 the no-JavaScript half built now, p1-070 the as-you-type half waits, for both sets). One increment for design question 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-045). Plants has no place of origin picker, so plants is unchanged. Ruling claim p1-047 says each design increment depends on the rows whose no-JavaScript version it builds on, so this draft makes it depend on the place of origin country search row (inc-089) and the germinal set's pickers (inc-181), where the existing row depended on nothing. Theme: waiting-on-design.
